name: Optima Automobile Group Holdings Limited
summary: Optima Automobile Group Holdings Limited, founded in Singapore in 2012 and headquartered there, is an investment holding company focused on vehicle aftermarket services. It has four segments: aftermarket automotive services such as inspection, maintenance and repair, car rental, automotive supply, and education business services. The supply business trades vehicles and parts in Singapore, Sri Lanka and Myanmar, and the company also offers franchise agency and spray painting.
